Question 25 (20 marks)

A business, Roo's Outback Eatery Pty Ltd, is opening an additional restaurant in NSW. They plan to position the restaurant as an exclusive restaurant specialising in modern Australian food with quality customer service. The owners require assistance with the following:

• additional funds for the day-to-day running of the business

• the close monitoring of working capital.

stimulus: Section III boxed scenario (no figures): Roo's Outback Eatery Pty Ltd, opening an additional NSW restaurant positioned as an exclusive modern Australian restaurant with quality customer service; owners need help with acquisition and development of suitable staff, additional funds for day-to-day running, and close monitoring of working capital. Crop also shows the standard 20-mark business report assessment criteria.

Question 26 (20 marks)

Kingland Office Supplies operates in a large NSW city in a highly competitive market. A paid manager is responsible for the day-to-day running of the business.

The owners are concerned about the low profitability of the business.

Investigations by the owners indicate the following problems:

• customers find the product mix unappealing

• poor management of cash flow

• poor accounts receivable turnover compared to similar businesses.

You have been employed as a consultant by the owners. Write a report to the owners recommending marketing and financial management strategies to improve the performance of the business.
stimulus: Boxed scenario (no figures): Kingland Office Supplies, a large NSW city business in a highly competitive market run day-to-day by a paid manager. Owners concerned about low profitability; identified problems are an unappealing product mix, poor cash flow management, and poor accounts receivable turnover compared to similar businesses, plus low prices offered by larger competitors. Crop also shows the 20-mark business report assessment criteria.

Financial data for Sportyz Goodz are shown on the graph.

stimulus: Boxed scenario plus a line graph. Graph: 'Amount (millions of $)' against Year 2012–2017, two unlabelled-value lines — Sales (starts highest in 2012, falls sharply to 2013, recovers to a 2014 peak, then declines steadily to 2017) and Profit (below Sales throughout, same shape — steep fall to a 2013 trough, 2014 recovery, then steady decline to 2017). No dollar values are printed on the axis; profit falls faster than sales so the gap between the two lines widens.

Emu Uniform Manufacturers Pty Ltd are a successful business based in NSW. They currently supply a range of school, sport and work uniforms to a large number of customers throughout Australia. They are known for their outstanding customer service and high quality products.

Sales have been increasing for many years and they have recently received a large long-term contract to supply uniforms to a major company.

• recommend a source of finance for the factory expansion

stimulus: Boxed scenario: Emu Uniform Manufacturers Pty Ltd, a successful NSW-based supplier of school, sport and work uniforms nationally, known for outstanding customer service and high quality.
